_about: Ground heights round Goodwood racecourse, metres above sea level, from the AWS Terrain Tiles (Mapzen 'terrarium', zoom 15; in Britain built from Environment Agency LIDAR and other open DEMs), sampled 17 Nov 2026 through the owner's built-in browser. Grid: east x and north y metres about lat 50.895, lon -0.742 (x = (lon+0.742)*111320*cos(50.895 deg), y = (lat-50.895)*110574). Rows run south to north (y0 upward), columns west to east.
